newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends down vs dlr as mark eases.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends down vs dlr as mark eases.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Friday's trading lower against the dollar reflecting the dollar's gains against the mark, dealers said.
The forint finished at 161.02/07 against the dollar, compared with the opening 160.81/86.
"The dollar firmed slightly due to the change in the dollar/mark," said Robert Szucs of Creditanstalt.
The forint remained steady against the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket, trading at the NBH's resistance level (bid) despite some customer orders for dollars, dealers said.
They added that thay did not expect the forint to move into the NBH's 4.5 percent wide floating intervention range early next week.

The dollar was mostly stable in futures trading on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), with only the March maturity easing by 60 fillers to 166.40, and that of September by 43 fillers to 177.97, the BCE said.
Yen futures, which closed mixed, were the focus of BCE trading on Friday, the bourse said.
